possible_model_blind_spots: OBSERVED-BASED INFERENCE: m75 and m32 repeats show that singleton loading minima or completion elevations can be unstable. A deterministic condition surface can overfit them unless repeated-input variation remains visible.
OBSERVED-BASED INFERENCE: historical excessive nitrile growth, insufficient aldehyde growth and excessive fused-ketone onset growth cannot be repaired by one signed polarity or carbonyl correction.

GENERAL CHEMICAL KNOWLEDGE: EA generally strengthens silica elution; increasing PE/EA weakens the mobile phase, and 0/1 is pure EA. Hydrogen bonding and functional-group accessibility can affect adsorption.

UNTESTED HYPOTHESES: adsorption nonlinearity, injection focusing, solubility, integration differences and unrecorded experimental variation could contribute to discrepancies. Endpoints alone do not distinguish them.

ml_scientist.possible_model_blind_spots: INFERENCE: Global molecular offsets or loading corrections cannot represent the observed endpoint-specific interactions and heterogeneous ratio slopes. ML PRIOR: Related structures can support transfer, but functional-group counts and broad descriptor similarity do not determine response shape. CHEMICAL PRIORS: Adsorption, focusing and hydrogen bonding remain possible explanations rather than measured mechanisms. Moving a failed transition hypothesis to a farther boundary solely because the model predicts growth there has weak evidential support.
ml_scientist.possible_learning_bottlenecks: INFERENCE: m75 and m32 repeats expose variation among identical represented inputs. Measurement variation, annotation/integration differences and omitted run conditions remain competing explanations. Two records per input do not identify an irreducible noise distribution or universal noise floor. ML PRIOR: Retain individual labels and provenance; use replicate-aware summaries and sensitivity checks so singleton extrema do not become deterministic surfaces. Training-only residuals and matched finite differences can distinguish poor fitting of acquired labels from a coverage gap. This packet cannot identify feature scaling, regularization, optimization or omitted variables as the cause.
